what: What the index conversion costs. The timing C of each case (merged tree, main 456c969 plus this branch) built three ways: default (cc -O2, checks on), release (-O3 -mcpu=native -DVIV_RELEASE), and release with viv_ix redefined as a plain (int) cast: no clamp of the double into int range and no negative-index wrap, which is what an integer index would cost (these programs use no negative index). All three print the same energy to 17 digits. Times from the in-program stage clocks, seconds, median of three interleaved runs.
